18 Classic Card Games.name: 18 Classic Card Games
18 Classic Card Games.summary: Play Texas Hold 'Em, Blackjack, Rummy, Hearts and many more classic card games on your Nintendo DS. Challenge up to 5 computer-controlled opponents -- bid your deck to max and take all the tricks in Skat, lay your cards down for a game of Solitaire, or make the bluff of your life in a hand of Poker. Step-by-step instructions are included for those who need to brush up on the rules. 18 Classic Card Games includes the following playing card games: Texas Hold 'Em • Omaha Hold 'Em • Casino Blackjack • Spanish Blackjack • Blackjack • Pontoon • Dutch Eenentwintigen • Rummy • Canasta • German Mau Mau • Dutch Pesten • Bridge • Dutch Klaverjassen • French Belote • German Skat • Freecell • Hearts • Klondike.

7 Wonders - Treasures of Seven.name: 7 Wonders: Treasures of Seven
7 Wonders - Treasures of Seven.summary: Match runes and break blocks as you build the world`s most wondrous structures in this ground-breaking Match 3 game! Rotate the game cubes to unlock each level with your keystone. Challenge your mind with intense, multi-layered puzzle cubes. Fill your life with wonder; buy 7 Wonders: Treasures of the Seven!

Babysitting Mania.name: Babysitting Mania
Babysitting Mania.summary:
Babysitting Mania is a simulation-style, time-management game developed by Gogii Games and iWin and available for OS X, Microsoft Windows and the Nintendo DS. The game allows the player to babysit many virtual children while cleaning the house and managing parties all under a certain time limit. The game is available for free as a download from iWin.com.

The player has a limited amount of time to keep the chaos meter down by clicking items with a red outline, washing clothes, or putting rubbish in the bin. If the player does not manage the chaos, the player will not be able to put the children to bed. If the player does not do it before the parents come home then the player will have to retry the level. To make it more difficult, there are different and larger houses in which the kids get more chaotic.

Burger Bot.name: Burger Bot
Burger Bot.summary: You’re a robot on a mission: to build the best hamburgers money can buy! As Burger Bot, you are in charge of creating the tastiest dishes in the fastest time possible. Use your Wiimote to serve up burgers, fries and soft drinks to multiple customers who patronize your business. Make them happy and get rewarded with more money to buy upgrades and unlock mini games.

Death Jr. and the Science Fair of Doom.name: Death Jr. and the Science Fair of Doom
Death Jr. and the Science Fair of Doom.summary: Death Jr. and the Science Fair of Doom brings back Death Jr, Pandora and the crew for a new adventure on the Nintendo DS. It's time for the annual school Science Fair, and DJ has gotten into another mess. He & his pals have unleashed Moloch into the school itself -- now they need to clean up the mess before DJ's dad finds out. Use the DS touch pad to execute cool scythe combos & switch between Death Jr. and Pandora. Help DJ, Pandora and the crew stop Moloch, save the school and keep out of trouble!

Digimon World DS.name: Digimon World DS
Digimon World DS.summary:
Digimon World DS, known in Japan as Digimon Story (デジモンストーリー Dejimon Sutōrī?), is a role-playing video game and the first Digimon game for the Nintendo DS. It is not part of the Digimon World series, as suggested by its localized title, but the game does bears a resemblance to Digimon World 3.

In the game, the player assumes the role of a Digimon tamer and embarks on a journey to discover, tame, raise, train and command more than 230 unique Digimon. The player can build Digi-Farms to raise, evolve and communicate with the Digimon. Using Wi-Fi and local DS wireless connection, players can interact by exchanging Digimon, engaging in battles, and pooling resources to create rare types of Digimon.

To date, the game has spawned four sequels in Digimon World Dawn and Dusk, Digimon Story Lost Evolution, Digimon Story: Super Xros Wars Red and Blue, and Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth.

Driving Theory Training.name: Driving Theory Training
Driving Theory Training.summary: Offers learner drivers the opportunity to practise for the theory test, boasting over 1000 questions from the official test. Also includes a selection of mini games such as 'Park your car' and 'Road sign memory games'.

DS Dengeki Bunko - Iriya no Sora, UFO no.name: DS Dengeki Bunko: Iriya no Sora, UFO no Natsu II
DS Dengeki Bunko - Iriya no Sora, UFO no.summary: DS Dengeki Bunko: Iriya no Sora, UFO no Natsu II is the second part of the DS Dengeki Bunko series.

Heroes of Hellas 2 - Olympia.name: Heroes of Hellas 2: Olympia
Heroes of Hellas 2 - Olympia.summary: Restore a failing civilization with wisdom and justice in Heroes of Hellas 2, a captivating sequel full of challenge and surprises! Shape it and its people by providing the resources to create a citadel of light, in a kingdom of darkness. Recover the Rod of Discord and vanquish the evil demon!

Magician's Quest - Mysterious Times.name: Magician's Quest: Mysterious Times
Magician's Quest - Mysterious Times.summary: As players attend Magic Academy, they'll be immersed in a living, breathing world where time flows as it does in the real world, and each week, player's wizardry skills are put to the test in a new magical adventure. Custom avatars can be made with 1,500 varieties of clothing, furniture and characters to choose from. Additionally, players can learn new magic spells and abilities by forming different bonds with the 150 unique characters populating the world. Different stories and adventures will be revealed depending on what bonds are formed with the game's characters and how the player chooses to solve each of the 52 adventures. Use more than 100 magic spells to become the greatest magician of all time!

Minna no Suizokukan.name: Minna no Suizokukan
Minna no Suizokukan.summary: The player helps out at an aquarium by taking care of animals, feeding them, and training them through a series of minigames.

Rhapsody - A Musical Adventure.name: Rhapsody: A Musical Adventure DS
Rhapsody - A Musical Adventure.summary: Port on the Nintendo DS, the gameplay has been changed significantly, and the battles are presented in 2D strategy-RPG type identical to the game's sequels. Kururu also engages in battle and the characters sprites are different in this version of the game.

Tangram Mania.name: Tangram Mania
Tangram Mania.summary: The most ancient puzzle known to mankind comes back in a new form on the most innovative console ever, the Nintendo DS! Play with the "seven pieces puzzle" anywhere you like, try to solve the puzzles already prepared for you, or create your own puzzles and challenge your friends to solve them! Old Game, New Fun!
